text:
maria: Posted the authn/authz postmortem (link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2365432100). I'm consolidating follow-ups into a closure checklist — please ACK, claim items, and add realistic ETA. We want concrete owners, timelines, and a recurring check for drift.

alex: Ack. I'll take the token validation hardening (fix TTL edgecases + add unit tests). Target: EOD Thu.

jin: I'll take audit logging gaps (missing request IDs and malformed payloads). Will add a retention/ingestion test and a saved query. ETA: next Tue.

samir: I can own secrets rotation policy for the affected service accounts. Plan: rotate keys, add automation, update runbook. Need infra help for HSM key import. ETA: next Wed for rotation, runbook update by Fri.

maria: Nice. Can @alex add a short smoke test command we can run from runbook so on-call can verify quickly?

alex: Sure. Adding quick smoke snippet to runbook:
```
# verify token validation errors in logs (k8s)
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_container" AND textPayload:"authz: token invalid"' --limit 50
# run unit tests for token decoder
pytest tests/unit/test_token_validation.py::test_expired_token -q
```

jin: Saved query for audit console (so SRE can pin it):
```
jsonPayload.requestId:* AND protoPayload.methodName:"Authenticate" AND severity>=ERROR
```
I'll attach retention patch to infra PR.

samir: For secrets, I'll run a canary rotate on staging, then schedule a maintenance window for prod. Runbook snippet I'll add:
```
# rotate service-account key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=my-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# update k8s secret and rollout
kubectl create secret generic sa-key --from-file=key.json=new-key.json -n default --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl rollout restart deploy/worker -n default
```

ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-1209: "Authn postmortem follow-ups". Claimed items: token-hardening (alex), audit-query (jin), secrets-rotation (samir). Recurrence: weekly drift check (every 7 days). Link: https://tracker.redwood/SEC-1209

maria: Putting consolidated closure checklist here for visibility (owners + due dates). Please update the ticket when items move.

```
- [ ] Token validation hardening — owner: alex — due: 2026-03-26 (EOD)
- [ ] Audit logging ingestion + retention test — owner: jin — due: 2026-03-31
- [ ] Secrets rotation + runbook update — owner: samir — due: 2026-04-01
- [ ] Add automated weekly drift check (alert on token TTL drift, missing audit events) — owner: ops-bot (SRE) — recurring weekly
- [ ] Post-change smoke verification added to runbook — owner: alex — due: 2026-03-26
```

alex: Acked and will push tests + smoke to PR today.

jin: I'll drop the saved query link into the ticket and add the retention config to infra PR.

samir: Scheduling staging canary now, will ping infra channel if I need HSM assistance.

maria: Thanks all. We'll review SEC-1209 in next Wed security sync; if anyone hits blockers earlier, ping me or escalate in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
